title: Enforcer result
description: One enforcer's answer for one device. An enforcer returns requested, applied, failed or unknown; only the controller writes confirmed, after its own read-back.

status.description: What the enforcer reports. The controller downgrades confirmed to applied and confirms by read-back.

mode.description: How it was done. bonus and allowance are for grant and allowance_today overrides.

confirmed_at.description: RFC 3339 with an explicit offset (Z or +hh:mm).

restore.description: Snapshot an emulating enforcer needs to put state back.
